purpose: Grounding bucket for Beluga passenger assistance. Stable airport facts are stored here; live flight, weather, security-wait, concession-hours and disruption data should come from live providers when available.

terminal_and_movement.main_terminal: The iconic Eero Saarinen Main Terminal contains airline ticketing/check-in on the Departures level and baggage claim/ground transportation on the Arrivals/Baggage Claim levels.

aerotrain.description: AeroTrain is the automated underground passenger train connecting the Main Terminal with midfield gate areas for domestic and international departures and domestic arrivals.
aerotrain.international_arrivals_note: Most international arrivals do not use AeroTrain before customs because they must first clear U.S. Customs and Border Protection.

terminal_and_movement.mobile_lounges: Dulles historically uses mobile lounge / plane-mate transport for some passenger movements; Beluga should not assume AeroTrain is the only possible gate-transfer mode.
terminal_and_movement.connection_guidance: For a specific connection, use the passenger's actual arriving and departing gates and live airport/airline data when available. Do not invent indoor walking times from this static bucket.

security.screening_available: Security screening is available 24 hours a day; checkpoint-specific lane hours can vary and should be treated as time-sensitive.
security.clear: CLEAR is available at Washington Dulles.
security.tsa_cares: TSA Cares can assist travelers with disabilities and medical conditions.
security.rule: Never infer or fabricate a current security wait from this context bucket. Use a live wait-time source when connected; otherwise say that a live wait is unavailable.

metro.station: Washington Dulles International Airport Metrorail Station
metro.terminal_access: The station is connected to the Main Terminal by an indoor pedestrian tunnel with moving sidewalks; the tunnel also connects toward Garage 1.
metro.live_data_rule: Use WMATA or another live transit source for current train times, fares and service advisories.

rental_cars.location: On-airport rental facilities on Autopilot Drive
rental_cars.terminal_pickup: From the Terminal Baggage Claim level, use the down ramp near Doors 2 and 4; rental shuttles use Curb 2C or 2D.
rental_cars.note: Some brands share shuttle buses, so passengers should verify the brand before boarding.

ground_transportation.taxi: Washington Flyer Taxi serves Dulles; accessible vehicles can be requested in advance.
ground_transportation.rideshare_and_prearranged: Use airport-designated pickup areas and the connected provider's live pickup instructions. Do not invent a curb/door when the provider is connected and can supply one.
ground_transportation.private_pickup: Arrivals curb is active loading/unloading only. Drivers should coordinate a numbered Arrivals Door; a Cell Phone Lot is available for waiting.
ground_transportation.kiss_and_fly: The airport promotes Kiss & Fly near the Silver Line station as an alternative drop-off point that can avoid terminal-curb congestion.

parking.terminal_parking: Closest self-parking option, directly across from the Main Terminal; pedestrian access includes an underground walkway.
parking.garage_1: Connected to the Terminal by an underground pedestrian walkway with moving sidewalks; free garage shuttle also operates.
parking.garage_2: Connected to the Departures/Ticketing level by a covered walkway; useful for many west-side/international airline functions; free garage shuttle also operates.
parking.economy: Lower-cost outdoor parking with free shuttle service to and from the Terminal.
parking.shuttles: Airport parking shuttles operate between parking facilities and the terminal. Exact headways and travel times are operational data and can change.
parking.pricing_rule: Parking prices are time-sensitive. If a current parking-price source is not connected, label stored rates as last-reviewed rather than live.

international_arrivals.customs: Except for passengers arriving from pre-cleared origins, international arriving passengers and their luggage must be processed by U.S. Customs and Border Protection.
international_arrivals.connections: Passengers connecting onward after CBP generally need to collect luggage, complete customs formalities, re-check luggage as required, and pass TSA screening again.
international_arrivals.terminating_passengers: Passengers ending their trip in the Washington area exit to the Terminal Arrivals / Baggage Claim level.
international_arrivals.meeting_area: A waiting area is available outside International Arrivals near Baggage Claim 15; pre-cleared international arrivals can use domestic-style exits.
international_arrivals.mobile_passport_control: Eligible travelers can use CBP Mobile Passport Control.

amenities.charging: Charging stations are distributed throughout gate areas and the terminal; additional charging is available in several dining areas.
amenities.chapel: Interfaith Chapel in Concourse A, directly across from Gate A32; described by the airport as always open.
amenities.uso: USO Lounge in the Main Terminal opposite Baggage Claim 12 for eligible military personnel and families.
amenities.nursing_rooms: The airport FAQ states there are eight nursing rooms throughout the airport.
amenities.baggage_storage: The airport does not provide a designated public luggage-storage area.
amenities.baggage_carts: Smarte Carte baggage carts are available at curbside, baggage claim and international-arrivals locations.
amenities.smoking: All indoor smoking lounges were permanently closed effective June 1, 2023.
amenities.kids: The FunWay children's play area is near Gate B70.

pre_security: Arrivals/Baggage Claim area near Baggage Claim 1

accessibility.commitment: MWAA states that Dulles public facilities and services are intended to provide universal access.
accessibility.wheelchairs: Passengers should arrange wheelchair assistance through their airline, preferably in advance.
accessibility.shuttles: Airport parking shuttle buses and rental-car shuttles have wheelchair lifts/ramps.
accessibility.sunflower: Hidden Disabilities Sunflower lanyards are available at the USO Lounge and airport information desks during posted service hours.
accessibility.restrooms_and_elevators: Accessible restrooms and elevators are available throughout the airport.

lounges.name: British Airways Lounge
